incidents.name: Incident on 2011-07-28 03:06:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-07-28 03:06:00 - One of our file servers failed over and we had a brief hiccup in availability. Continuing to investigate.
  • 2011-07-28 05:43:00 - Our fileserver issues have been fully resolved!

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-07-27 16:25:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-07-27 16:25:00 - One of the file servers is out of disk space. We're fixing it now.
  • 2011-07-27 17:20:00 - The file server was fixed a while ago. Missed the nagios resolution.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-07-16 20:39:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-07-16 20:39:00 - One of our file servers is having issues. We're looking into it.
  • 2011-07-16 22:03:00 - File servers are back to normal

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-06-22 23:50:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-06-22 23:50:00 - The database is experiencing high load during a modification operation on the events table. Working on it.
  • 2011-06-22 23:54:00 - Everything is back and functional. We experienced high load on the DB server while dropping a large legacy table. Sorry for the hiccup.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-06-16 18:05:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-06-16 18:05:00 - We're seeing elevated error rates trying to push/pull via ssh right now, we're investigating the issue.
  • 2011-06-16 22:30:00 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-06-14 16:09:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-06-14 16:09:00 - Our zip/tarball downloading service is down. We're looking into it.
  • 2011-06-14 16:44:00 - We're serving zip/tarball downloads again. Carry on!

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-06-09 02:35:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-06-09 02:35:00 - The site will be down for maintenance in 30 minutes:\r\n\r\nhttps://github.com/blog/872-scheduled-maintenance-tomorrow-20-00-pst
  • 2011-06-09 03:00:00 - Going down for maintenance now. Expected downtime: 10 minutes.
  • 2011-06-09 03:10:00 - And we're back! Thanks.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-06-08 02:14:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-06-08 02:14:00 - Site is down due to a botched redis restart. We're on it. Be back shortly.
  • 2011-06-08 02:19:00 - And we're back.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-06-02 08:33:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-06-02 08:33:00 - Reports of downtime in Netherlands and Japan. We're investigating.
  • 2011-06-02 09:06:00 - Connectivity restored.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-06-02 02:26:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-06-02 02:26:00 - One of the file servers is switching to standby while we diagnose a problem.
  • 2011-06-02 02:27:00 - Access to repos on that file server has been restored on the standby server.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-05-31 23:34:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-05-31 23:34:00 - Some users are having troubles pushing to their repos. We're looking into it.
  • 2011-05-31 23:35:00 - Repos should be fixed now. A repo shard was left in a weird state, so we weren't receiving alerts for it.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-05-26 17:28:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-05-26 17:28:00 - A bug crept into our Javascript bundling process, so some functionality on the site may be broken. We're looking into it.
  • 2011-05-26 17:30:00 - And it's fixed!

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-05-15 05:00:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-05-15 05:00:00 - Scheduled maintenance is starting. Should not last more than 15 minutes.
  • 2011-05-15 05:29:00 - Maintenance was successful. Thanks for your patience.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-05-05 19:14:08 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-05-05 19:14:08 - Major failures across the site. We're investigating.
  • 2011-05-05 19:25:13 - Disruption was due to temporary database overload. We're researching the cause. The site has stabilized.
